name.title: Name
name.description: The platform name shown in the Homebridge log.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address for the Roborock account that owns or has access to the vacuum.

password.title: Password
password.description: Roborock account password. Used for password login or as a fallback when no encrypted token is available.

encryptedToken.title: Encrypted Token
encryptedToken.description: Encrypted Roborock session data. This is created and managed by the plugin UI after a successful login.

skipDevices.title: Skip Devices
skipDevices.description: Comma-separated Roborock serial numbers or DUIDs to ignore during discovery.

baseURL.title: Region
baseURL.description: Roborock cloud region endpoint. Choose the region used by your Roborock account.

debugMode.title: Debug Mode
debugMode.description: Write verbose Roborock API, discovery, and transport diagnostics to the Homebridge log.

transientWarningThrottleHours.title: Transient Warning Interval
transientWarningThrottleHours.description: Hours between repeated transient timeout warnings for each vacuum. Use 0 to hide these recurring warnings unless debug logging is enabled.

enableMatterServiceArea.title: Enable Matter Room/Map Selection
enableMatterServiceArea.description: Adds Matter Service Area room and map selection to the Matter vacuum for clients that support it. Disable this if a Matter controller gets stuck showing the vacuum as Updating.

enableLiveRoomTracking.title: Enable Live Room Tracking
enableLiveRoomTracking.description: While a B01/Q7-series robot is actively cleaning, periodically fetch the robot's map position (every ~20 seconds) and report the room it is physically inside as the current Matter Service Area, so controllers like Apple Home can show 'cleaning in <room>'. Requires Matter Room/Map Selection. Disable to avoid the extra map traffic.

enableMatterPowerSource.title: Enable Matter Battery
enableMatterPowerSource.description: Adds the Matter battery/power-source cluster to the Matter vacuum. Disable this if a Matter controller gets stuck showing the vacuum as Updating.

enableMatterCleanMode.title: Enable Matter Cleaning Mode Selection
enableMatterCleanMode.description: Adds Matter vacuum/mop cleaning mode selection to the Matter vacuum. Disable this if a Matter controller shows the vacuum as No Response after pairing.

enableFanPowerCleanModes.title: Enable Suction-Level Cleaning Modes
enableFanPowerCleanModes.description: Adds Quiet / Balanced / Turbo / Max vacuum modes to the Matter cleaning mode list, so suction can be chosen directly from Apple Home. IMPORTANT: Matter fixes the mode list when the robot is paired, so after enabling or disabling this you must remove the robot from Apple Home and re-pair it once. Requires Matter Cleaning Mode Selection.

enableMatterExtendedOperationalStates.title: Enable Matter Dock & Returning Status
enableMatterExtendedOperationalStates.description: Opt in to the extended Matter statuses: Returning to the dock, Emptying the dust bin, Washing the mop, and Updating maps. Requires removing and re-pairing the robot in Apple Home once, because Matter fixes an accessory's capabilities at commissioning. Which of these Apple Home actually renders is Apple's decision. Unless Charging/Docked status is also enabled below, docked and charging still report as Ready. Note: Roborock's mop DRYING has no equivalent in the Matter robot vacuum specification, so it cannot be reported by any plugin.

enableMatterChargingDockedStates.title: Enable Matter Charging/Docked Status
enableMatterChargingDockedStates.description: Report real Charging and Docked states so the Apple Home tile shows Charging/Docked instead of Ready. Requires a recent iOS/tvOS; if the tile shows odd status text or pairing misbehaves after enabling, turn this off again and restart the Roborock bridge.

enableMatterFaultReporting.title: Report Faults in Apple Home
enableMatterFaultReporting.description: Show a robot that has genuinely stopped working as Error instead of Ready: stuck, a blocked brush or wheel, a missing dust bin, a flat battery, a dock it cannot reach. Off by default because a robot reporting Error may be refused a Start command by Apple Home. Dock and tank conditions (empty clean-water tank, full waste-water tank, missing dust bag) are NOT reported: field testing showed Apple Home does not draw Matter vacuum faults at all, so reporting them was pure cost.

matterChargedBatteryThreshold.title: Charged Battery Threshold (%)
matterChargedBatteryThreshold.description: Battery percentage at which a docked robot switches from Charging to Docked on the Apple Home tile. Default 100. Lower it (e.g. 90) if a worn battery makes the robot report fully charged early.

enableHomeKitActionSwitches.title: Add Home App Switches for Dock, Pause and Find
enableHomeKitActionSwitches.description: Publishes one extra HomeKit switch per robot per action, so Apple Home automations and Shortcuts can send a command that Apple does not offer for a Matter vacuum. Measured in issue #3: Apple Home has no "send the vacuum to its dock" automation action for a Matter vacuum, and a plain switch is an automation action everywhere. Each switch is momentary: it turns itself off again about a second after it is pressed. Off by default, because turning it on adds accessories to your Home app.

homeKitActionSwitches.title: Which Switches to Add
homeKitActionSwitches.description: Which actions get a switch. Return to Dock is the one Apple Home cannot do any other way; Pause and Find are there because they cost nothing extra once the first switch exists. Only used when the setting above is on.

cloudOnlyMode.title: Use Roborock Cloud Only
cloudOnlyMode.description: Disables local LAN discovery and local TCP commands for this plugin, routing commands and status polling through Roborock cloud when available. Useful when local LAN connections appear connected but consistently time out. Restart the Roborock child bridge after changing this setting.

preferCloudForMatterCommands.title: Prefer Roborock Cloud for Matter Commands
preferCloudForMatterCommands.description: Sends Matter vacuum commands through the Roborock cloud when cloud transport is connected. This can avoid local LAN command timeouts on some models, such as S8. Status reporting is unaffected.
